scoreboard.scope: Primary: strict119 post-hoc historical-use sensitivity results — 119 cases left after excluding 17 originally marked-fresh cases with measured use in smoke train or v2 dev. This is not a newly independent test.
scoreboard.pair_definition: A pair is handled when the valid row UPDATEs to the target answer and the unsupported-toward row uses an acceptable action (CLARIFY or RETAIN) while keeping the prior answer.
scoreboard.backend_note: v5 and v6 quality counts are the stored original seed-0 AuditKIT outputs, restricted to strict119. The evidence-prompt arm is base Tiny Aya Global with greedy vLLM generation and a 192-token budget. The NLI gate uses DeBERTa-v3-base-mnli-fever-anli at its declared-default 0.5 threshold without tuning.
